profile_metadata_refresh.reason: The stored rankings are historical and correspond to the ranking-input hash recorded at matcher runtime. P.G. Instruments changed a score-affecting product term after official catalog review found no listed products in its GC 650 category. Spinflex removed an unsupported ESR/EPR-only qualifier from its spinAMP amplifier description and aligned the capability wording with its official product page. The current ranking-input hash is recorded separately. The local environment lacks sentence-transformers, so no fresh matcher run was possible; do not interpret these historical rankings as current-profile evaluation results. ON NANO also removed unsupported glass-core-substrate and high-density-packaging claims; this stored ranking predates that profile correction. GeniCore corrected the CUBNEC expansion and exact lexical terms based on its official applications page; the paired current-model evaluation showed no top-five ranking changes. SALD now classifies the patented deposition head as a feature of its R&D system rather than a standalone product; its paired evaluation showed no top-five ranking changes. SALD removed a generic reactor-like process label from standalone products while retaining atmospheric pressure ALD as a supported system capability; paired rankings were unchanged. Thesix added official product names for fuel-cell humidification and heated gas transfer hardware; a matched 18-case synthetic run had no top-five ranking changes.
